subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about paid subscriptions landing on top of your organic curve. New context worth flagging: only 2% of US households now pay for a generative AI subscription, yet that base grew 155% year over year, so the paid window is opening fast while qualified-subscriber CPAs in this category run between $50 and $500. That spread is exactly where first-paid-event optimization and incrementality decide your real cost per paying subscriber, the way Jasper and Copy.ai already buy. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: timely US AI-subscription penetration jump (2% base, 155% YoY, sourced) + market CPA band $50-$500
